claims.claim_text: The indexed David E. Brownson is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact full-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated July 19, 1945; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS assignment or entry date.
claims.match_notes: The record supports enlisted Army status. The unusually late Army-entry date makes it especially important not to assume the Army-to-OSS sequence.

research_attempts.query_text: Mary E. Browning: visually checked NARA index; NARA and CIA OSS context; exact-name and meaningful variants with OSS, employer, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, military, and archival terms; current loc.gov Chronicling America API result-image review; OSS Operational Groups roster.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Exact-name newspaper, directory, obituary, and genealogy candidates lacked OSS evidence, a full middle name, or Box 87 linkage. A 1945 Cincinnati typist and several Mary E. Browning newspaper subjects remain unassigned.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 87 for full middle name, birth year, hometown, occupation, employer, and OSS assignment before evaluating exact-name directory candidates.

research_attempts.query_text: Philip W. Browning: visually checked NARA index; NARA and CIA OSS context; exact-name OSS, employer, writer, military, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches; current loc.gov Chronicling America API result-image review; OSS Operational Groups roster.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A 1932 Michigan-writer reference and a 1944 First Lieutenant of the exact name provide no OSS or Box 87 linkage and no two corroborating identifiers beyond the name. Other namesakes were similarly unsupported.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable identity or pre-OSS employer has yet been established.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 87 for birth year, hometown, education, branch or civilian status, employer, OSS assignment, and evidence needed to evaluate the writer and officer candidates.

research_attempts.query_text: David E. Brownson: visually checked NARA index; exact private-identifier Army bulk, technical-documentation, and occupation-code review; exact-name OSS, CIA, accountant, auditor, employer, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, military, and archival searches; Chronicling America; OSS Operational Groups roster.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Discovery-only pages repeat Army data but name no employer. Pre-birth newspaper hits are unrelated. The Army occupation category names no employer, and the July 1945 Army-entry date does not prove the OSS sequence.
research_attempts.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the Army identity. Only the qualified accountants-and-auditors occupation group is published; no employer or immediate pre-OSS role is inferred.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 87 for the named employer, precise job, OSS entry date, Army-to-OSS chronology, and any intervening assignment.
